summary_en: On September 9, 2026, the board authorized expansion of the self-share buyback program from 400,000 shares (4.44% of outstanding shares) to 900,000 shares (9.99%), with the total acquisition budget raised from ¥300 million to ¥925 million through February 5, 2027. A block purchase of 500,000 shares (5.55% of outstanding shares) for ¥573 million was executed via ToSTNeT-3 at ¥1,146 per share on September 10, 2026.
title_en: Notice on Expansion of Self-Share Acquisition Framework and Self-Share Purchase through Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
Harima Vystem announced on September 9, 2026, that its board had expanded the self-share buyback authorization previously approved on February 6, 2026. The acquisition limit was increased from 400,000 shares (4.44% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock) to 900,000 shares (9.99%), and the maximum acquisition amount was raised from ¥300 million to ¥925 million. The acquisition period remains from February 6, 2026, through February 5, 2027, with the same methods: off-hours trading via ToSTNeT-3 and on-exchange purchases.

On the same day, the company executed a block purchase of 500,000 shares (5.55% of outstanding shares) for ¥573 million via ToSTNeT-3 at ¥1,146 per share on September 10, 2026. As of August 31, 2026, the company had cumulatively acquired 306,900 shares for ¥292.3 million under the February authorization, comprised of 300,000 shares via ToSTNeT-3 for ¥285.3 million and 6,900 shares via on-exchange purchase for ¥7 million.

The company stated that the expansion aimed to improve capital efficiency and implement flexible capital allocation policies responsive to changes in the operating environment. The buyback program forms part of shareholder returns announced in the company's mid-term management plan (fiscal 2026–2028) issued on May 14, 2026.
